# Coherent DP-PAM4 Optical Communication System: Pure NumPy Interactive Comparison Version
This is a DP-PAM4 simulator built purely using NumPy and SciPy, without relying on any deep learning frameworks. In this version, the core DA/DD-LMS equalizer is calculated symbol-by-symbol using a native Python for loop. Please feel free to scroll through the console below and experience the real "lag" without JAX compilation acceleration!
